flow: built private React login served with strict CSP
invalid credentials are generic and rate limits honor Retry-After
bootstrap login requires forced password rotation
expired rotation session returns to login before retry
password rotation invalidates the previous session and returns to login
signed OAuth query remains byte-for-byte intact through login
rotated owner can sign in and reach the existing admin route
sign out returns to unauthenticated login
recovery form is not exposed in normal owner mode
one-time local recovery completes and returns to fresh login
recovered owner can sign in with the replacement password
